items.title: Central bank officials hint at slower pace of rate cuts
items.summary: Officials at the latest policy meeting signalled that further rate cuts may come more slowly than markets expected, which tends to weigh on non-yielding assets such as gold.

items.title: Safe-haven demand rises after border tensions flare in a neighbouring region
items.summary: Investors moved part of their portfolios into safe-haven assets after reports of renewed border tensions, supporting demand for gold-backed funds.

items.title: Jewellery retailers report steady autumn sales
items.summary: A survey of retailers in a major market showed seasonal jewellery demand broadly unchanged from last year.
